image.title: Generate 3D models from reference images
image.intro: Upload a photo or concept art and get a matching 3D model — no modelling from scratch.
points: Start from a single image, or add more to cover other angles.
Set face count and size for the intended use.
Keep refining materials and convert formats for downstream work.

text.title: Generate 3D models from a text description
text.intro: No reference image? Describe the shape, style and material and get the model you need.
points: Just describe the object — no images or model files needed first.
Choose realistic, cartoon or other styles to match your project.
Set face count and size, then refine materials and file formats.
text.prompt: A fantasy cottage with a curved red-tile roof, blue timber frame and white plaster walls on a stone base, in a hand-painted cartoon style.

agent.title: Let an AI agent make 3D for you
agent.intro: Tell the agent what model you need and it calls the generation and processing tools; pair it with Blender to build out the scene.
points: Give requirements or a reference image in chat and let the agent generate the model.
Have the agent check progress, download results and organise files.
For full scenes, use Blender to place objects and set up lights and cameras.

print.title: Turn photos and ideas into figurines, ornaments and custom pieces
print.intro: Convert images or text into detailed 3D models, export print files and make your own figurines, ornaments and custom objects.
points: Watertight by design, less hole-fixing: closed, manifold models cut slicing errors from holes and non-manifold edges and reduce pre-print repair.
Fine structures still print: thin walls, slim rods and local detail hold their shape and strength at the target size.
Standard print formats for mainstream slicers: export STL / 3MF and drop into your existing print workflow.

game.title: Generate characters, props and scenes to prototype games faster
game.intro: Turn concept art or text into textured 3D assets, skip modelling from scratch and validate gameplay and scenes sooner.
points: Controllable face count, detail and performance: tune geometry per asset so characters, props and set pieces fit your budget.
Full PBR materials, less manual setup: colour, roughness, metallic and normal channels for faithful materials in-engine.
Multi-format delivery for your tools: GLB / FBX / OBJ and more for editing, level building and prototyping.

film.title: Previs the scene and shots first, then generate AI video
film.intro: Use an agent with Blender to turn shot descriptions into grey-box reference video, giving AI video clear composition, space and motion.
points: One scene, many shots: lock characters, props and layout, then switch camera positions to previs different shots without rebuilding.
Real 3D cameras, controllable framing and moves: focal length, position and path previs dolly, pan and tracking before you generate.
Continuous grey-box video, clear action and timing: spatial relationships, character motion and shot timing as a coherent reference.

agents.title: Built for Agents.
agents.lead: Aholo3D pairs composable 3D capabilities with clear tool definitions and compact, structured outputs agents can pass between steps—supported by planning, validation, and task management.

items.d: Generate, texture, repair, split, rig, animate, remesh, and render. Combine individual operations to process existing assets or build an entire workflow.

items.t: Help Your Agent Plan and Verify.
items.d: Get a production plan, budget, and cost breakdown before execution. Inspect inputs and validate outputs so your agent can make informed decisions throughout.
High concurrency lets your agent generate and process multiple assets at once. Aholo3D returns results when ready, without repeated status checks or custom polling scripts.
Keep assets in a shared cloud library. Continue with another connected agent, or open them in the web app to create, edit, and share.
Built-in workflow skills guide your agent through 3D printing and game asset production, from selecting operations to checking final deliverables.
